title: HR
html:
15.4.1Leave report

The leave list of one or more employees for the specified time interval, in XLS format.

15.4.2Detailed leave report

It also contains the leave that has been requested but not yet approved, broken down by day.

15.4.3Consolidated leave report

It also contains the sick leave and the days worked.

15.4.4Consolidated report

It also contains the total annual leave and the leave used.

15.4.5Working time records

It displays the attendance sheet of the employees and allows export to Excel.
